title: Spices and specialty foods ranked by retail price (dollars per gram)

source.name: Retail spice and specialty-food pricing
source.publisher: industry pricing guides cross-checked against typical US grocery/specialty pricing

notes: Black pepper and cinnamon are conservative round estimates from typical US grocery pricing. Whole vanilla beans (~$0.60/gram) and fresh black truffle (~$4/gram) are conservative estimates from typical specialty-retailer pricing. Saffron uses the $15/gram midpoint of its cited $10-30/gram 2026 retail range.
